sections.title: WHAT IS ALOPECIA?
bullets: Alopecia areata – hair loss in patches
Alopecia totalis – complete loss of scalp hair
Alopecia universalis – loss of all body hair
text: Alopecia is an autoimmune condition that causes hair loss.
The immune system attacks hair follicles, leading to hair loss.
It often affects men and women of all ages. Scalp tattooing helps.
